_comment: QM-0001 test floor, enforced by scripts/verify-baseline.sh. The floor may only ever be RAISED; a task that lowers it is rejected in review. Counts were measured on the commit below by running `cargo test --workspace` and `cd apps/web && npx vitest run`. Derivations for every cli_golden value are in .plan/evidence/QM-0001.md.
_commit_field_note: The _comment above says the counts were measured on `commit`, so this field is repinned in the same change that moves a count. QM-0030 measured 477/45 on f4fba1e, its implementation commit. 6fb593a ('pin baseline.json to its merge commit') shows the controller may repin this to the merge commit when the branch lands; that is a repin of a true value, not a correction of a false one. Web counts were NOT re-measured on f4fba1e beyond confirming they are unchanged at 115/13, because QM-0030 changed no web file.
_rust_floor_raised_by: QM-0011 — 677 tests over 51 binaries is the floor recorded at both e82fe98 (the dispatched base) and e49ac24 (the branch's actual parent after an external `reset: moving to main` recorded in the reflog at 2026-08-05 17:03:09); raised to 706 over 52 after adding the cross-family resolver conformance suite. Exactly +29 tests: crates/q-nsir/tests/resolver_conformance.rs 28 (a new binary, hence 51 -> 52), plus crates/q-nsir/src/resolver.rs +1 (the characterization test recording the unanchored `experts.` marker; 55 -> 56). 677 + 29 = 706 reconciles exactly, which is also the check that no pre-existing test was removed, weakened, or #[ignore]d. 677/51 was measured by `cargo test --workspace` at e82fe98 and is valid at e49ac24 and at main (1ea382d) too, because `git diff e82fe98 main --name-only -- crates/ architectures/ fixtures/ scripts/ apps/` is empty and this file reads 677/51/115/13 at all three refs. 706/52 was measured on the working tree that became the QM-0011 commit. Web counts are untouched at 115/13: QM-0011 changed no web file. Two other branches raise this floor concurrently; the controller reconciles at merge. Derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0011.md. Previously:QM-0101 — 545 tests over 45 binaries is the floor recorded on base d49701c; raised to 624 over 47 after adding the configured resident ceiling, the MEMORY_BUDGET.md §11 precedence chain, the checkpoint-level residency pass, and the `q stream` verb. Exactly +79 tests: q-source/src/config.rs 14, q-tensor-runtime/src/residency.rs 15, tests/tests/bounded_residency.rs 26, tests/tests/residency_peak_allocation.rs 1, plus q-source/src/budget.rs +3, q-source/src/local.rs +5, q-tensor-runtime/src/stream.rs +6, q-cli/src/main.rs +9. 545 + 79 = 624 reconciles exactly, which is also the check that no pre-existing test was removed, weakened, or #[ignore]d. The two new binaries are tests/tests/bounded_residency.rs and tests/tests/residency_peak_allocation.rs. Derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0101.md. Web counts are untouched at 115/13: QM-0101 changed no web file. Previously: QM-0030 — 434 over 43 measured on base 6fb593a, raised to 477 over 45 after adding the bounded streaming block reader (crates/q-tensor-runtime/tests/bounded_residency.rs and real_fixture_blocks.rs); see .plan/evidence/QM-0030.md.
_qm_0101_measurement_note: 624/47 was measured by `cargo test --workspace` on the working tree of branch task/qm-0101-bounded-residency-proof at base d49701c, NOT on commit 703903d or on d49701c itself — base d49701c yields 545/45, which is why that is the floor these counts were checked against. `commit` is left at its previous value rather than repinned to a self-referential SHA: the counts cannot be measured on the commit that records them without an amend cycle that invalidates the SHA it just wrote. The controller repins this field at merge, exactly as 6fb593a did.
_cli_golden_provenance: No expected value below was produced by q-cli. Tensor, shard and payload counts and the exact scalar come from fixtures/tiny-llama-2shard/golden.json, generated by Python safetensors==0.8.0. Layer rows and the planned matmul shape are arithmetic over the fixture's own config.json. Block statistics were computed from golden.json's f32 bit patterns. Each value is matched as a substring of the command's whitespace-squeezed stdout.
